mirrored.summary:
I mirrored the Design canvas "HalalGoes Customer — Cart & Checkout" (version 1791088974-a066) to disk: 75 files, 1,202,554 bytes. That is 70 `.dc.html` boards, `canvas.json`, and a pinned copy of the design system under `ds/halalgoesdesignsystem-d11a47/` (`tokens.css`, `tokens.json`, `components/bundle.js`, `components/bundle.css`). The copy comes from https://claude.ai/artifact/1GwGVZz8Ju9wcz4HfCnzbv, version 1790605103-3266, taken 2026-10-01. The canvas has no `project/api/` cards. I skipped `artifact-type/`, `index.html` and `SKILL.md` as instructed. The boards reference `./support.js`, which is not published in the artifact, so it is not in the mirror.

The canvas has two screen families.

**F5 Cart (25 boards):**
- **Main states:** default (priced from the quote; the canvas marks it interactive), quoting, loading, empty, error, and offline (an 868px-wide multi-frame board).
- **Order and line actions:** order already on the way, line updating, line removed with Undo, Undo failed, line at the maximum of 20, and edit a line.
- **Unavailable items:** out of stock, size sold out, extra ran out, removed from the menu, and price changed.
- **Restaurant problems:** restaurant closed, restaurant unavailable (with no halal cause), and certification lapsed (EXPIRED). The lapsed board uses a slate notice, never red.
- **Other:** no address (estimate only), below the minimum order, clear-cart confirm, dark mode (titled "Not for approval": blocked on dark halal tokens in the design system), and text at 1.3× and 2.0×.

**F6 Checkout, payment and hand-off (45 boards):**
- **Setup:** ready, the hand-over sheet, tip and tip too high, prices updated, the address sheets, the pay sheet, add a card (a 1728px board with 4 frames), no card, the wallet and wallet cancelled, and card expired.
- **Placing and payment failures:** placing, double tap, processing, declined, another way to pay, bank confirmation (3DS) and its failure, deadline passed, retries used up, quote stale, and checking.
- **Blocks:** order already on the way, a race found while placing, blocking errors (a 2700px-tall board), finish profile, address out of range, unavailable, halal lapsed, error, dark, text at 2×, and tax review.
- **After placing:** Order placed, Order placed with cancel, Order placed (authorized), Order preparing, declined then cancel, the cancel states (1298px wide), and order cancelled ("put these items back", 1728px wide with 4 frames).

**Which files hold the real content.** Each board is a self-contained 390px phone frame of about 6–15 KB. They are built from `HalalGoesDesignSystem_d11a47.*` components (AppBar, Card, HalalBadge, Price, Button, IconButton, Badge, Icon) plus sample cents values. Each board carries inline annotation chips:
- "Bound:" says which contract field feeds the element, e.g. `cart.indicative_subtotal_cents`, `getActiveOrder`, `createQuote` / `getQuote`.
- "Trigger:" says which blocking reason or state shows the board.
- "Component gap:" names components not yet in the design system: Banner, QuantityStepper, MediaFrame.
- "Needs API:" and "Contract to confirm:" mark proposed contract changes, e.g. `shortfall_cents` for the minimum-order shortfall, and `getCart` returning halal state for an expired restaurant.

The wide multi-frame boards are the largest files: `Checkout-finish-profile` (51 KB), `Checkout-cancel-states` (47 KB), `Checkout-offline` (28 KB), `Cart-offline` (24 KB), plus `Checkout-blocked`, `Checkout-cancelled`, `Order-placed-cancel` and `Checkout-declined-cancel` (about 17–18 KB each). Thinner variant boards include `Cart-empty`, `Cart-error`, `Checkout-error`, `Checkout-unavailable` and `Checkout-halal-lapsed`.

**Notes in `canvas.json` for builders.** A blue note says the canvas was split from "HalalGoes Customer — Discover & Order" (https://claude.ai/artifact/F2MfULPYoJQkkLsA5G3aFk). A gray "Checkout notes" note records these points:
- **Delivery instructions:** an array in the contract. The hand-over choice is one of three (a photo for Leave at the door, a code for Meet), plus two optional flags.
- **Tax:** tax rows show the quote's tax lines exactly as returned. There are none at launch while the HST registration question is open. The service fee line always shows, even at $0.00 (owner decision).
- **Tips:** tip presets are customer inputs and the server validates `tip_cents`. Riders see the tip before they accept (owner decision).
- **Not drawn:** promo codes (a later release) and package tamper seals (out of launch, owner decision).
- **One active order at a time:** owner decision. An order under review (DISPUTED) does not count (owner decision, 1 October).
- **After `createOrder`:** the order exists unpaid with a 15-minute deadline. A decline, a failed bank confirmation and a closed wallet sheet all recover on the same payment, or the customer cancels for free. A second `createOrder` is never sent.
- **Put these items back in your cart:** the cart is deleted when the order is created. After a cancelled, expired or failed unpaid order, this option re-adds the lines with one `addCartLine` per line and the server prices them again. No contract change is needed.
- **Still open:** the cancel reason at the payment stage. It is drawn to the contract (the customer picks a reason, nothing pre-selected); the alternative is a fixed "changed my mind" reason with no step.
